items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I had to send my mother to San Diego to get the two kids -- Johanna and Délores, her two children, my oldest sister's two children.

ctx.x: what religion she was, from Baptist to the religion she had finally chosen. But what can I say. So I let her go ahead. And they don't want you to visit your cemetery, they don't want you to recognize the birthdays, they don't recognize nothing. That's that Jehovah Witness belief -- Kingdom Hall and all that. She spends more time knocking on people's doors to tell them about the Bible than she does finding out whether her children are right or wrong. So half of her kids are going the wrong way because of that.…

And anyway, that's the youngest sister. The oldest sister died in 1928 or 1929- she died. I was playing at the Radio City Music Hall the time she died. She died in San Diego. I had to send my mother to San Diego to get the two kids -- Johanna and Délores, her two children, my oldest sister's two children. I had to send my mother there to get them. So she went there to get them and brought them back and at that time I had a mix-up with Nazarro and

Buck because I wanted to change the whole set-up with Buck and Bubbles with Nat Nazarro at this time and I couldn't get -- I wanted to establish an account at the bank under the name of Buck and Bubbles. That's what I wanted to do. Understand? And all the checks that Buck and Bubbles would get would go in the bank and would dispose of the money (inaudible). Well, it was hard for me to get Buck to do anything, and I didn't never have enough money. My half of the salary, my part of the salary wasn't sufficient to…
